messages:
Nina: Noticed onboarding sample logs show empty request IDs when LOG_LEVEL=verbose + OTEL_ENABLED=1. Repro on Linux VM.
Luis: I can repro. Looks timing-related with retries.
Rohit: Minimal order-sensitive snippet:
```js
app.use(telemetry.otelHook())
app.use(telemetry.logHook())
```
Rohit: otelHook does async context set, logHook reads sync. If retries kick in you sometimes log before ctx populated.
Nina: With REDACT_SENSITIVE=true the header may even be stripped during retry, odd.
Luis: Short-term fix: initialize telemetry before mounting routes (await telemetry.init()).
Rohit: Added fallback in logHook to check req.headers['x-request-id'] if ctx empty. Filed TW-5510.
telemetry-bot: Issue TW-5510 created: "node-sdks: fallback for reqid when otel init race"
Nina: Let's gate sampleapp deploy until a tested fix lands.
